# Information Object

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:InformationObject`](gmeow-InformationObject.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/InformationObject>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/kernel`](../../slices/kernel.md)

An entity whose nature is to carry information content: a document, dataset, software artifact, online account, or message. The shared parent of the document, software and account layers.

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gmeow:Entity`](gmeow-Entity.md), [`gufo:Object`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-object)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:InformationObject`](gmeow-InformationObject.md) as a specialized kind of [`gmeow:Entity`](gmeow-Entity.md), [`gufo:Object`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-object). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.
